hook.situation: The same 겠 appears in three very different moments: a staff member makes a formal promise, a researcher infers from data, and a colleague declines politely. You need to hear which job 겠 is doing before you translate it.
objectives: Use -겠습니다 for formal commitment and service speech.
Use -겠네요/-겠군요 for confident inference from evidence.
Separate 겠 from -(으)ㄹ 거예요 and -(으)ㄹ 것 같아요 in future, inference, and softened refusal.
hook.whyItMatters: English often reduces 겠 to 'will,' but Korean uses it for register and stance. 확인하겠습니다, 피곤하시겠네요, and 참석하기 어렵겠습니다 all contain 겠, but they do different social work.

grammarNotes.title: V-겠어요 / V-겠습니다 - formal commitment
grammarNotes.mentalModel: When the speaker controls the action, -겠습니다 often sounds like 'I will take responsibility for this now.'
grammarNotes.formation: Attach 겠 to the verb stem, then add the ending: 확인하겠습니다, 처리하겠습니다, 도와드리겠습니다. In first-person service or workplace speech, this is more committed and formal than -(으)ㄹ 거예요. 확인할 거예요 can sound like a plan; 확인하겠습니다 sounds like a promise to the listener.

examples.en: I will check the order right away.
examples.note: Service promise; the speaker takes responsibility.
도와드리다 plus -겠습니다 is standard polite service Korean.

examples.en: I will not be late again.

exceptions: Do not use -겠습니다 for every casual future plan. 친구 만날 거예요 is a plan; 친구 만나겠습니다 sounds formal, stiff, or like an announcement.

grammarNotes.title: A/V-겠네요 / A/V-겠군요 - inference from evidence
grammarNotes.mentalModel: When the speaker looks at evidence and draws a conclusion, 겠 means 'it must be / I can infer.'
grammarNotes.formation: Attach 겠네요 or 겠군요 to verbs/adjectives. Use it when you have a visible clue, data, a result, or what someone just told you: 피곤하시겠네요, 어렵겠네요, 결과가 달라지겠네요. Compared with -(으)ㄹ 것 같아요, 겠네요 feels more evidence-based and confident.

examples.en: Looking at the data, it looks like the result will change.

examples.ko: 표정이 안 좋은 걸 보니 많이 피곤하시겠네요.
examples.romanization: pyojeongi an joheun geol boni manhi pigonhasigenneyo.
examples.en: Seeing your expression, you must be very tired.
If your schedule is this busy, it must be really tough.
If the explanation gets long, it will be hard to understand.

exceptions: If you are merely guessing without evidence, -(으)ㄹ 것 같아요 is often safer: 비가 올 것 같아요. Use 겠네요 when the reason is present enough to infer from.

grammarNotes.title: V-(으)ㄹ 거예요 - future plan, not service commitment
grammarNotes.mentalModel: -(으)ㄹ 거예요 states what will happen or what you plan to do. It does not automatically carry the formal responsibility of -겠습니다.
grammarNotes.formation: Attach ㄹ 거예요 after vowel stems and 을 거예요 after consonant stems. Use it for personal plans and ordinary future statements. In a service setting, however, -겠습니다 is often more natural because the listener expects a committed action, not just a prediction.

examples.en: I am going to meet a friend tomorrow.
I am going to check email after the meeting.
examples.note: Plain plan, not a service promise.
In service speech this is stronger than 확인할 거예요.

examples.en: I am going to rest on the weekend.

grammarNotes.title: A/V-(으)ㄹ 것 같아요 - tentative guess
grammarNotes.mentalModel: Use -(으)ㄹ 것 같아요 when you want a softer, less certain prediction than 겠네요.
grammarNotes.formation: Attach ㄹ 것 같아요 after vowel stems and 을 것 같아요 after consonant stems. This form is intentionally cautious: 늦을 것 같아요, 어려울 것 같아요, 가능할 것 같아요. It is useful when you do not want to sound too sure.

examples.en: I think I will be a little late today.
I think this method might be possible.
I think we may need more data/materials.
I think the result may change.

exampleSentence.en: I will check the order right away.
I'm sorry, but it will be difficult for me to attend today.
There are times when you have to decline politely.
Eoryeopgesseumnida is often used in courteous refusals.
Looking at the data, it looks like the result will change.
It looks like the result will change.
I will help the customer right away.
I will check the order right away.
Then I will wait a little.

If the explanation gets long, it will be hard to understand.

extendedDialogue.setting: A workplace chat moves through service commitment, evidence-based inference, and polite refusal.

readingText.title: 겠의 세 가지 얼굴
readingText.body: 겠은 단순히 미래를 말하는 표현이 아니에요. 직원이 손님에게 주문을 확인하겠습니다라고 말하면, 그냥 미래 계획이 아니라 지금 책임지고 처리하겠다는 약속처럼 들려요. 반대로 자료를 보니 결과가 달라지겠네요는 자료라는 근거를 보고 내린 추론이에요. 또 죄송하지만 참석하기 어렵겠습니다처럼 말하면 못 가요보다 훨씬 정중하고 부드러운 거절이 돼요. 그래서 겠을 볼 때는 먼저 상황을 봐야 해요. 내가 하겠다는 약속인지, 근거를 보고 추측하는지, 아니면 말을 부드럽게 만드는지 구분해야 자연스럽게 쓸 수 있어요.
readingText.bodyTranslation: 겠 is not simply a future marker. When a staff member says 'I will check the order,' it sounds like a responsible promise, not just a future plan. By contrast, 'Looking at the data, the result will change' is an inference from evidence. And saying 'I'm sorry, but it will be difficult for me to attend' is a much more courteous and softened refusal than simply saying 'I can't go.' So when you see 겠, look at the situation first. Is it a promise that I will do something, an inference from evidence, or a way to soften speech?

comprehensionQuestions.question: 자료를 보니 결과가 달라지겠네요는 어떤 겠이에요?
참석하기 어렵겠습니다는 왜 써요?
comprehensionQuestions.answer: 거절을 정중하고 부드럽게 말하기 위해 써요.

culturalNote.title: 서비스 말투의 책임감
culturalNote.body: In Korean service and workplace settings, -겠습니다 often signals professionalism. 제가 확인하겠습니다, 바로 처리하겠습니다, 도와드리겠습니다 all tell the listener that the speaker is taking responsibility. In private plans, -(으)ㄹ 거예요 is more natural. In refusals, 어렵겠습니다 softens the message without sounding evasive.
culturalNote.tip: If the sentence is about a promise to the listener, try -겠습니다. If it is a private plan, use -(으)ㄹ 거예요. If it is a cautious guess, use -(으)ㄹ 것 같아요.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which sentence is a formal service commitment?
options: 주문은 제가 바로 확인할 것 같아요.
inlineExercises.explanation: -겠습니다 marks a formal commitment controlled by the speaker.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which sentence uses 겠 for inference from evidence?
inlineExercises.explanation: The data gives evidence for the speaker's inference.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which sentence is the most courteous formal refusal?
inlineExercises.explanation: 어렵겠습니다 softens the refusal in formal speech.

bullets: Inference: 자료를 보니 결과가 달라지겠네요, 많이 피곤하시겠네요.
-(으)ㄹ 거예요 is an ordinary future plan; -(으)ㄹ 것 같아요 is a tentative guess.
